items.name: dsh-plugin-market

items.name: dsh-research
items.desc: Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).

items.name: dsh-store

items.name: dsh-plugins-store

items.name: dsh-mcp-market
items.desc: MCP server marketplace for DSH: browse a curated, npm-verified catalog and install MCP servers into the current profile with one click, live without restart.

items.name: dsh-plugin-manager

items.name: dsh-insight
items.desc: Plugin insight center: one answer to "哪些值得装" — plugin_guide matches needs to plugins, recipe installs whole environments, plugin_rank scores health (0-100), plugin_audit static-scans a local checkout for security, and plugin_verdict outputs install / caution / research / avoid.

items.name: dsh-plugin-console
items.desc: Browse and manage the community plugin catalog from a first-level DeepSeek Harness Settings page, with verified installs and updates, removal, pause and resume, installed-package state, and sanitized README previews.

items.name: dsh-plugins-marketplace

items.name: plugin-registry#console
items.desc: Ecosystem infrastructure: a thin browser console for managing official repository plugins (zero patches) plus a make-dsh-plugin skill for guided plugin development.

items.name: dsh-skin-market
items.desc: Native skin marketplace and lifecycle manager that discovers community skins, displays previews and compatibility status, and provides verified one-click or manual installation paths.

items.desc: GUI in the DSH settings panel: toggle/delete MCP servers, browse and trash skills, and list built-in plugin packages — hot-applied without restart.

items.name: dsh-plugin-manager

items.name: dsh-workshop
items.desc: Steam Workshop-style plugin store for the DSH Web UI: browse, search, and one-click install community plugins with mirror acceleration, progress UI, security checks, and Chinese descriptions.

items.name: dsh-plugin-market

items.name: dsh-plugin-suite#dsh-plugin-center
items.desc: Plugin center: discover, install, and manage DSH plugins from Settings.

items.name: dsh-plugin-suite#dsh-plugin-updater
items.desc: Update manager for installed plugins: check for updates, back up, and roll back.

items.name: plugin-switch
items.desc: Toggle switches for the plugin inventory: enable/disable any plugin live from Settings → Plugins → Plugin list without restarting, with groups/filters, bulk toggle, undo, and backup.

items.name: dsh-plugin-doctor
items.desc: Community search, similarity analysis, and install/dedupe/build-it-yourself decisions for the dsh-plugin ecosystem.

items.name: dsh-forge
items.desc: Runtime extension suite for DeepSeek Harness: cross-session mailbox with wake cold-start, agent teams (captain + members + dependency task board + team_wait), subagent spawn policy with escalation approval, task-aware routing preset, plugin market, skill manager and runtime injector.

items.name: dsh-starter-pack
items.desc: A curated plugin starter pack: batch-installs and configures 15 vetted community plugins across four groups from a Settings-page UI or the /setup command.

items.name: dsh-plugin-panel
items.desc: In-app DSH plugin marketplace panel with curated and full catalogs, keyword and semantic search, Chinese translation, favorites, installed-state tracking, and install/update/uninstall via the official CLI.

items.name: dsh-plugin-manager
items.desc: In-web plugin manager for DeepSeek Harness: categorized plugin list, preset bundles with one-click switching, import/export and failure auto-rollback, plugin market with one-click install.

items.name: dsh-plugin-audit
items.desc: Ecosystem-wide plugin health audit: syncs the dsh-plugin topic into a local scored catalog (maintenance / docs / npm + weekly downloads / ecosystem, 0-100, A-D), static security scan with high-finding grade veto, star history snapshots, web leaderboard and agent tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-advisor
items.desc: Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result.

items.name: dsh-plugin-manager#cli
items.desc: The `dsh pm` plugin manager: multi-source search (awesome list + GitHub + npm), install/remove/update per profile, and a doctor audit of manifests, bundle patches, and version drift.

items.name: dsh-plugin-market
items.desc: A plugin market for DeepSeek Harness: search and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugin plugins straight from the web GUI.

items.name: dsh-theme-switch
items.desc: One-click skin switching for DSH Web settings: auto-detects installed themes, keeps exactly one active at a time, and falls back to the official look when all are off. Changes apply instantly and survive restarts.

items.name: awesome-dsh
items.desc: Turns a stated need into a plugin choice: an agent skill that queries a catalog of the whole `dsh-plugin` topic (2600+ repos, recrawled every 6 hours, Chinese descriptions from Workers AI) through a ranked search API, then hands back the matching `dsh plugin add` command.

items.name: dsh-plugin-toggle
items.desc: Toggle, delete, undo-delete, and check/update plugins from the Web settings panel; runtime enable/disable is persisted to the profile.

items.name: dsh-feed
items.desc: Cross-ecosystem aggregation data layer: syncs the GitHub dsh-plugin topic and the npm registry into one open JSON index, queried by model tools, a CLI, and a minimal stdio MCP server.

items.name: dsh-need-finder
items.desc: Requirement-driven dsh plugin discovery and environment recipes: plugin_guide matches natural-language needs to a curated plugin directory with reasons and install commands; recipe installs whole setups (通知全家桶, 安全审计套装...) from bundled community bundles with ordered plans.

items.name: dsh-plugin-recommend
items.desc: Plugin recommender for DSH: search and rank plugins from an embedded 1100+ entry marketplace catalog by need description, category and tags, with match reasons and a live catalog refresh from the awesome-dsh-plugin README.

items.name: dsh-recipe
items.desc: Scenario bundles of dsh plugins (插件界的 dotfiles): a recipe tool that lists, searches, applies and composes ready-made plugin environments with ordered install sequences.

items.name: huahua-dsh-plugin-orchestra
items.desc: A plugin management system for DeepSeek Harness: plugin inventory with L0/L1/L2 AI purpose summaries, changelog tracking, update alerts, one-click upgrade, and backup/rollback with crash recovery.

items.name: dsh-plugin-scout
items.desc: Scouts the deepseek-harness repo and every dsh-plugin-tagged repository to discover harnesses related to your goal, then judges each as worth trying, watching, or skipping.

items.name: find-dsh-plugins
items.desc: Conversational DSH plugin finder: four-source unified index, BM25 pre-filter plus LLM semantic ranking, candidates carry evidence grades and local static security audit, safe install flow with post-install verification.

items.name: dsh-plugin-scorecard
items.desc: Quality & security scorecard for the DSH plugin ecosystem: sync the dsh-plugin topic catalog, audit any plugin (0-100, A-D, security veto), rankings, search, and historical score curves with a workspace-persisted catalog.

items.name: dsh-plugin-market
items.desc: Browse the awesome-dsh-plugin catalog from a page in DSH Settings: filter by category or by installed state, search by name or description, sort by stars, downloads, name or date added, and install a plugin into the current profile. Two further tabs list what is already installed and which of those have a newer version in the catalog, with an update button on each row. The update view reports installed plugins whose update status cannot be determined, and overlapping install requests are refused. The catalog is cached locally for an hour with a mirror, a CDN and the npm registry as fallbacks when the official source is unreachable.

items.name: dsh-bridge
items.desc: Slash commands ported from other coding agents (setup, connect, install, trust, browse, doctor, status, model, memory, compact, resume, review, mcp, init, suggest, improve, refactor), a zero-dependency static scanner for plugin source, and an in-repo catalog of audited plugin report cards that cite file-and-line evidence.

items.name: dsh-plugins#to-english
items.desc: Rewrites the Chinese copy of a market-installed plugin into English using a model already configured in the harness — automatically when the plugin is installed, then live-reloaded. Each file is translated in one whole-file pass, validated by a real parser where one exists (node --check for JavaScript, JSON and YAML parsers otherwise) and handed back to the model with the error for up to three repair attempts; files above 48 KB, or that never parse, fall back to a line-range pass that checks every returned line against the original for structure. Trigger phrases and locale tables can optionally be preserved rather than translated, and the untouched original is kept beside the file as a .zh.bak.

items.name: dsh-skills-marketplace
items.desc: Manage, discover, install, update, and uninstall DSH skills as plugins.

items.name: dsh-agent-plugin-market
items.desc: Manage Git-backed DSH plugin markets, installed agent skills and optional Codex hooks from the web settings page.

items.name: dshhub-market
items.desc: Passcode marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: enter a six-character code to unlock and install plugins shared by creators, plus themes, backup, updates and diagnostics.

items.name: dsh-find-plugins
items.desc: Find DSH plugins across several community catalogs plus live GitHub and npm search, ranked by relevance, trust, freshness and bounded popularity instead of stars alone.

items.name: dsh-plugin-ops#dsh-plugin-ops-bundle
items.desc: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.

items.name: dsh-rank-board
items.desc: Ranks the top 400 DSH plugin candidates by live npm download counts and shows the top 200, with daily, weekly and monthly boards.

items.name: dsh-autocompose
items.desc: Find and compose DSH plugins from a task description, then open an independent chat environment or install the plan into the current profile.

items.name: dsh-cli-store
items.desc: 64-entry external CLI catalog with bounded public discovery and guarded package-manager or manual official installation, exposed through DSH tools and a standalone command.

items.name: dsh-plugin-share
items.desc: Turn a set of DSH plugins into one pasteable share code, then install it plugin by plugin — with a QR code to carry it to a phone.

items.name: dsh-mall
items.desc: The complete #dsh-plugin mall inside DeepSeek Harness: browse, search and score the full GitHub dsh-plugin topic catalog refreshed every 2 hours, AI pre-install review with install/caution/avoid verdicts, five-dimension scores with radar charts, nine-language UI, editor picks and personalized recommendations, one-click install/update/rollback with a global task panel, and an in-agent /dsh-mall skill.

items.name: dsh-m
items.desc: In-app plugin marketplace for DSH: plugin discovery, install, upgrade, toggle and uninstall in one panel for Web and Desktop host profiles, pairing a community catalog of 4,000+ entries with customizable curated lists, plus eight agent tools and a standalone dshm CLI, without a marketplace server or account.

items.name: dsh-dejaview
items.desc: Checks whether a similar dsh plugin already exists before you build one, searching the awesome-dsh-plugin registry and the dsh-plugin GitHub topic and returning ranked matches with evidence.

items.name: dsh-unified-market
items.desc: Unified plugin marketplace built for the DSH Desktop (EAC) shell, aggregating the curated catalog, the GitHub dsh-plugin ecosystem and the npm registry into one storefront, with source whitelisting, conflict pre-checks, trial-boot install verification, manual/batch/auto updates and .dshpack feature-pack management.

items.name: dsh-vibe-pack
items.desc: Transactional data-only configuration pack manager with integrity, ownership, preview, diff, and rollback safeguards.

items.name: dsh-local-installer
items.desc: Local plugin installer in the DSH web Settings: a file picker for .tgz plugin packages (multi-select) or a full machine path, installing them into the auto-detected profile via the official `dsh plugin add` with live CLI output — no terminal needed.

items.name: dsh-plugins-hub
items.desc: Plugin marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar catalog tab plus agent tools (mp_search, mp_similar, mp_details, mp_install, mp_trending) backed by dsh-plugins-mp.com.

items.name: dsh-batch-uninstall
items.desc: Adds a Batch Uninstall page to the DSH settings dialog: a checklist of every installed bundle with multi-select, select-all, a confirmation dialog and per-plugin progress, where official bundles stay locked and each removal goes through the host pluginManager service.

items.name: dsh-stock-mentions
items.desc: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.

items.name: dsh-mcp-market
items.desc: MCP marketplace and management panel in the Web sidebar: one-click official templates (Apifox public/private, Apipost, MasterGo, Pixso), paste raw mcpServers JSON, and enable, edit or delete your services with hot reload.

items.name: dsh-archive-manager
items.desc: Archive manager for DSH Web: list archived sessions in the Settings page and delete them for real, including their log, archive marker, and projection cache.

items.name: dsh-employee
items.desc: Digital Employee，Integrates three catalogs — Experts, Skills, and Connectors — supporting browsing, favoriting, invoking, and publishing without modifying the host.

items.name: dsh-deepatlas
items.desc: Task-aware DSH plugin navigator: builds a local index from GitHub topics and community lists, retrieves across 28 bilingual capability classes, and provides commit-level static risk audit, consent-gated pinned installation, composition checks, and recovery.

items.name: dsh-plugin-mgr
items.desc: Card-style plugin manager in Settings: enable/disable each plugin through the profile patch layer, install-source details, npm update check with one-click update, uninstall, search, and load-error badges.

items.name: dsh-market-sidebar
items.desc: Adds a dshmarket entry to the DSH sidebar footer, sharing a row with the Agents-Anywhere remote-control entry and sitting to its right, and opens the market panel in an overlay.

items.name: dsh-plugin-marketplace
items.desc: Browse, search, star-sort, favorite and one-click download community plugins from inside DeepSeek Harness settings.

items.name: dsh-skill-market
items.desc: Skill marketplace with unified search across SkillHub and ClawHub, in-app README preview, one-click install and uninstall, an installed-skill list, and a chat-input skill picker.

items.name: dsh-plugin-autoupdate
items.desc: Plugin updater for DeepSeek Harness that delegates every version decision to the dsh CLI, so the pnpm release-age policy still decides what is eligible; it snapshots before applying, can roll back, keeps a lock list, and can check or auto-apply on a schedule the user turns on.

items.name: dsh-plugin-install
items.desc: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.

items.name: dsh-plugin-store
items.desc: Adds a native Store section to DSH Settings for catalog search, tag filtering, sorting, installation, and installed-plugin management.

items.name: dsh-plugin-marketplace
items.desc: Browse and search GitHub dsh-plugin repositories from Web UI Settings, sort by stars, and install plugins through the DSH CLI.

items.name: dsh-agent-plugins-market
items.desc: Install suites from any Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi or agent-plugins.org git marketplace repo — skills, MCP servers, hooks and slash commands are injected into DSH sessions at runtime, with a market page in the Web GUI.

items.name: dsh-settings-sync
items.desc: Exports the plugin profile together with selected $DSH_HOME files and browser localStorage into one JSON, imports it back after a per-file preview, and can run pnpm install to reinstall the listed plugins; the format is interchangeable with the dsh-market profile backup.

items.name: dsh-plugin-diraud
items.desc: Installed-plugin catalog for DSH: group plugins by origin (official vs self-installed) in a searchable panel with enable/disable, uninstall, and one-click update. Published on npm as dsh-plugin-diraud.

items.name: experts-management

items.name: dsh-disable-unofficial-plugins
items.desc: Adds a checkbox-style switch at the right end of the Installed group header on the DSH Plugins page: it opens a checklist of the unofficial plugins, all checked by default, and toggles only the ones you keep checked. Once everything is off the button flips to enabling them again. Disable/enable only — it never uninstalls a plugin or deletes plugin files and configuration, and its UI copy follows the app language.

items.name: dsh-bootstrap
items.desc: DSH onboarding plugin: recommends plugins across eight domains ranked by weighted GitHub stars and npm monthly downloads, installs the recommended set in one click behind a reviewable plan, and exports or imports an environment code recording a profile's plugin list, exact versions and enabled flags.

items.name: dsh-expert-market
items.desc: Expert market for DeepSeek Harness: WorkBuddy expert/expert-team system ported onto native agent presets, 425-expert catalog installed on demand, capability subtraction, and team delegation tools.

items.name: dsh-plugin-index
items.desc: Plugin index inside DSH that lists over 10,000 third-party plugins checked against the dsh.bundle manifest in their package.json rather than by star count, with one-click install and a companion website.

items.name: dsh-web#packages/dsh-plugin-manager
items.desc: Plugin manager tab in DSH Settings → Plugins: install from npm or git with progress, enable/disable switches effective at next startup, conflict reconciliation with undo, and one-click hand-off to a fix session.
